entry.author: NMITNZ
entry.summary:
Thinking about studying in New Zealand? Discover what it’s like to study at NMIT in Te Tauihu, the top of the South.

This brand video offers a glimpse into student life at Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology (NMIT), where hands-on learning, industry connections and a supportive study environment come together. From aviation engineering and aquaculture to trades, nursing, viticulture, creative industries and technology, NMIT helps students build real-world skills for real careers.

Whether you’re looking to study in Nelson, Marlborough or elsewhere in New Zealand, NMIT offers practical, career-focused education in a region known for its lifestyle, natural beauty and strong industry links.

Explore your options and find out more at nmit.ac.nz
